explanation: OEIS A260194 (a(n+1) = a(n) + gcd(a(n), a(n−2)), a(1) = a(2) = a(3) = 1): 'Does every positive integer occur as a difference in this sequence?' The formal a is the same recurrence shifted to start at index 0, and the statement asks that for every d > 0 some consecutive difference a(n+1) − a(n) equals d. This is the positive form of the question. Faithful.
